title.zh: 将高山省 本格特 Kabayan市镇区 Kabayan 中央学校的名称变更为Bansen 纪念学校的法案
title.en: An Act Changing the Name of the Kabayan Central School in the Municipal District of Kabayan, Benguet, Mountain Province, to Bansen Memorial School
title.orig: An Act Changing the Name of the Kabayan Central School in the Municipal District of Kabayan, Benguet, Mountain Province, to Bansen Memorial School
title.vi: Đạo luật đổi tên Trường Trung tâm Kabayan tại Quận Kabayan, Quận Benguet, Quận Mountain Province thành Trường Tưởng niệm Bansen
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนชื่อโรงเรียนกลาง Kabayan ในเขต Kabayan เขต Benguet เขต Mountain Province เป็นโรงเรียนอนุสรณ์ Bansen
title.id: Undang-Undang Mengubah Nama Sekolah Pusat Kabayan di Distrik Kabayan, Distrik Benguet, Distrik Mountain Province menjadi Sekolah Memorial Bansen
title.ms: Akta Menukar Nama Sekolah Pusat Kabayan di Daerah Kabayan, Daerah Benguet, Daerah Mountain Province kepada Sekolah Memorial Bansen

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1957/ra_1650_1957.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The name of the Kabayan Central School in the Municipal District of Kabayan, Benguet, Mountain Province, is hereby changed to Bansen Memorial School.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 20, 1957.
